title: model-catalog: add capability filters, compatibility flags, pricing & streaming stability fixes
author: Ethan Kim
description: Motivation: Users and downstream SDKs need stable discovery primitives from the model catalog to drive routing, pricing UI, and OpenAI-compatibility layers. This PR standardizes capability filters (streaming, function calling, structured output), surfaces compatibility flags used by the OpenAI compatibility layer, and adds pricing/limits metadata used by the console and API rate-limiting logic. Also fixes a streaming stability regression introduced in the streaming proxy during high-concurrency tail latencies. What this PR does: 1) API changes: extends GET /v1/models and /v1/models/:id to return new top-level fields: capabilities (list of capability keys), compatibility_flags (list of strings that indicate OpenAI compatibility modes), pricing_tiers (string key) and limits (stringified summary used by UI). Query params: supports ?capabilities=streaming,function_calling,structured_output and combinatorial filtering (comma-separated). Also supports ?openai_compatible=true to return models with OpenAI compatibility flags. 2) Backend: model registry schema migration (add capability and flag indices), indexing for fast capability filters, and a small pricing metadata table join. 3) Runtime/serving: streaming proxy fix to ensure KV-cache warmup and backpressure signaling are respected when a model variant falls back to a non-streaming variant; added a small jitter on batch flush to avoid synchronized bursts. 4) SDK/compat: updates in the OpenAI-compat layer to prefer models with openai_compatibility flag and surface the new pricing/limits fields in the compatibility response. 5) Docs: updated model catalog API doc section and sample responses. Notes on compatibility: changes are additive on the API surface. Existing clients that ignore unknown fields are unaffected. The OpenAI-compat layer behavior is opt-in via the new query parameter or explicit SDK selector. Testing and CI: Added unit tests for capability filter parsing and integration tests that exercise GET /v1/models with mixed capability sets. Synthetic load test that reproduced the streaming regression shows stable tail latencies after the backpressure fix. CI initially flagged lint issues and a flaky streaming test; both were resolved in follow-ups. Rollout plan: feature-flag the new capability query parsing for 24 hours while monitoring model-catalog request latency. If no regressions, fully enable and update SDKs next release. References: Linear ENG-4123 (model catalog capability filters), ENG-4290 (streaming stability), SUP-1182 (customer report of missing pricing fields).

release_notes: Added capability filters to model listing (streaming, function_calling, structured_output) and new compatibility_flags + pricing_tiers + limits metadata. Fixed streaming proxy backpressure causing tail latency regressions. Backward compatible.
user_impact: API consumers can filter model listings by capability and opt-in to OpenAI compatibility discovery. Console will show pricing/limits for catalog models. No breaking changes expected.
